description: Source code for Android audio preprocessing effects, including effects like Automatic Gain Control (AGC), Acoustic Echo Cancellation (AEC), and Noise Suppression (NS). Implements effect creation, configuration, processing, and management within the Android audio framework.

classes.name: preproc_effect_s
classes.description: Represents an individual audio effect instance, including its state, configuration, and effect operations.

classes.name: preproc_session_s
classes.description: Manages a session of multiple effects, including configuration, state, and WebRTC audio processing integration.

methods.name: Effect_SetState
methods.description: Transitions an effect between different states (init, created, active, configured) and calls appropriate effect operations.

methods.name: Effect_Init
methods.description: Initializes an effect with a specified effect ID, setting its interface and state.

methods.name: Effect_Create
methods.description: Creates an effect instance within a session and sets its initial state.

methods.name: Effect_Release
methods.description: Releases an effect, resetting its state.

methods.name: Session_Init
methods.description: Initializes a session, setting default parameters and effect states.

methods.name: Session_CreateEffect
methods.description: Creates and attaches an effect to a session based on effect ID.

methods.name: Session_ReleaseEffect
methods.description: Releases an effect from a session.

methods.name: Session_SetConfig
methods.description: Configures session parameters such as sample rate and channels.

methods.name: PreProc_GetSession
methods.description: Retrieves or allocates a session for a given effect and session ID.

methods.name: PreProc_GetDescriptor
methods.description: Returns effect descriptor based on UUID.

methods.name: PreProcessingFx_Process
methods.description: Processes audio stream through enabled effects.

methods.name: PreProcessingFx_Command
methods.description: Handles control commands for effects, including configuration, state changes, and parameters.

methods.name: PreProcessingFx_GetDescriptor
methods.description: Returns effect descriptor for a given effect handle.

methods.name: PreProcessingFx_ProcessReverse
methods.description: Processes reverse audio stream for effects that support it.

methods.name: PreProcessingLib_Create
methods.description: Creates an effect instance based on UUID and session parameters.

methods.name: PreProcessingLib_GetDescriptor
methods.description: Retrieves effect descriptor based on UUID.
